note: Replaces the inline addDashboard call with runBlankDashboardFlow, passing isLoading/setIsLoading from newDashboardLogic; also adds menu click analytics.
Adds an includeTime action and reducer to the testing logic; error-tip selector branch order and error kinds are untouched.
Adds last_vacuum_version properties on ExternalDataSchema and load.py reads them instead of indexing sync_type_config directly.
Extracts the timeout wrapper into exported withBackgroundTaskTimeout, documents double-resolve as a no-op, adds tests and a force-resolve config flag.
Removes the separate ssl_enabled switch and adds a require_tls field inside the shared SSH tunnel config (model, wizard, form); Postgres reads it from ssh_tunnel.
Switches the artefact diff endpoint from commit SHA to branch-vs-default-branch and documents the task:write boundary; no signals-specific scopes are added.
Adds a lib column and swaps the result cap to a new ACTIVITY_EVENTS_MAX_LIMIT constant; no shared pagination serializer is used.
Deletes the Stripe source-level force-refresh OAuth workaround from validate_credentials and just maps the expired-connection error message.
Extracts a PickerRow component; TemplateRow and StartWithAiRow both render it instead of duplicating the button shell.
Adds an exported autoRunMaxPrompt helper in scenes/max/maxPrompt.ts and uses it instead of hand-prefixing the prompt with '!'.
